notes: DOCUMENTED TARGET — NOT RECORDABLE (agent_supports: partial; daemon_capability: incapable). This spec states the arc the row asserts so a future re-assessment has something concrete to compare against; it is NOT expected to pass on pi 0.83.0 and is deliberately not weakened to match what pi can do. THE ROW: ready -> working -> waiting entered while a dialog that belongs to NO tool call is on screen, then waiting -> working -> ready after the user answers, then a >=15s trailing idle that catches a session left pinned at waiting. AGENT LAYER (partial): pi raises exactly one of the row's four triggers — the built-in project-trust prompt (docs/security.md:5-26, docs/settings.md:12; dist/core/project-trust.js:9's ctx.ui.select is the only ui.select( call site in the whole non-vendor bundle, awaited inside createRuntime at dist/main.js:552, so it genuinely blocks and belongs to no tool call). But it fires BEFORE session_start (docs/extensions.md:280-282), so no send can elicit it and there is no working state to leave — the turn_start phase below has no pi spelling. The other three triggers are absent: no sandbox/network confirmation (docs/security.md:31 'No Built-in Sandbox'), no MCP elicitation (README.md:495 'No MCP'; /elicit/i = 0 hits across docs+dist), and the only product-raised settings review is the PI_EXPERIMENTAL=1 first-time setup (dist/main.js:484), also pre-session. TRANSPORT LAYER (why this cannot pass): while the dialog is up, pi has written NOTHING under the watched root — dist/core/session-manager.js:722-751 does not create the session .jsonl until an assistant message exists, a fact this repo's own replaydata/agents/pi/driver-interactive.sh already records ('there's nothing to read at boot'). The decision lands in ~/.pi/agent/trust.json, a sibling of sessions/ rather than a child, and only AFTER the answer — so even a widened watch could mark the release edge and never the entry. The only session-shaped row that exists is the scanner's proc-<PID> pre-session (core/cmd/irrlichd/wiring.go:103), born ready and never working. And the hook channel installs exactly one event, agent_settled (hookinstaller.go:128): project_trust is excluded because its ctx is a reduced trust context with no sessionManager and therefore no transcript path — the only key this adapter correlates a session on (hookinstaller.go:125-127, hooks.go header). Neither edge of the episode reaches any Source irrlicht reads, which is incapable, not bug. FALSE-POSITIVE WARNING: this schema cannot assert 'no tool call is in flight', so if a pi recording of this row ever went green the phases most likely bound to a different waiting episode — pi's transcript-tail trailing-'?' prose cue, or SignalOpenToolStalled on a slow write/edit (stalledEditToolThreshold=30s). A re-record must confirm from the transcript that no tool_use block was open at the entry edge.

text: The prompt starts the turn → working
A dialog carried by no tool call opens → waiting, entered while it is on screen (the row allows up to 15s for agents that publish the signal on a timer)
User answers the dialog → back to working; nothing but the answer carries the release
Session is still ready at the end of a >=15s trailing idle — it does not fall back to waiting, and it was not left pinned at waiting from the dialog onward
Driver tears the REPL down → process_exited on the session
